qualifier: cerebellar layering and locomotor behavior
name: Hindbrain–cerebellar motor-circuit development and locomotor behavior
rationale: Members cover pons, brainstem, cerebellar layer, striatum and substantia nigra development plus motor learning, walking and reflex behaviors; cerebellar layering and locomotor behavior distinguish it from confusables focused on hindbrain nerve guidance, forebrain development or vocal/auditory behavior.

qualifier: cytokine induction
name: C-type lectin receptor antifungal signaling and cytokine induction
rationale: Members share Dectin-1/Dectin-2/DC-SIGN and fungal/protozoan recognition driving IL-10, IL-12, IL-23, GM-CSF and IFN-gamma production, which the Th1, interleukin-signaling and anti-inflammatory confusables lack.

qualifier: clathrin-mediated endocytosis and postsynaptic receptor internalization
name: Clathrin-mediated synaptic vesicle recycling and receptor endocytosis
rationale: Members concern clathrin coat dynamics, synaptic vesicle endocytosis and recycling, spontaneous release and postsynaptic receptor internalization, distinguishing it from confusables on vesicle docking/fusion exocytosis and AMPA trafficking.

qualifier: NLRP1/NLRP3 control of interleukin-1 processing
name: NLRP1/NLRP3 inflammasome regulation of interleukin-1 production
rationale: Members share NLRP1/NLRP3 inflammasome activity and IL-1 alpha/beta processing and regulation, whereas confusables center on pyroptosis, AIM2/CASP4/5 inflammasomes, IL-18 or chemokine production.

qualifier: mesendoderm formation and mesodermal cell migration
name: Mesendoderm formation and mesodermal cell migration at gastrulation
rationale: Members concern germ layer and mesendoderm formation, mesodermal fate and cell migration during gastrulation, distinct from confusables on lateral plate mesoderm, primitive streak/EMT, endoderm or heart morphogenesis.

qualifier: COPI intra-Golgi and Golgi-to-ER retrograde transport
name: Golgi structural organization and COPI-mediated intra-Golgi traffic
rationale: Members cover Golgi ribbon formation, disassembly/reassembly, positioning and COPI-dependent intra-Golgi and retrograde traffic, unlike confusables on COPII ER export or TGN-endosome-lysosome sorting.

qualifier: excitotoxic neuronal stress and AMPK signaling
name: Excitotoxic neuronal stress, AMPK signaling and microglial activation
rationale: Members link kainate/NMDAR-driven hippocampal neuron stress and CAMKK-AMPK signaling with microglial differentiation, activation and proliferation, while confusables center on microglial phagocytosis, amyloid response and cytotoxicity.

qualifier: regulation of MHC expression
name: Interferon-gamma signaling and regulation of MHC expression
rationale: Members share IFN-gamma receptor signaling and its regulation with MHC class I/II biosynthesis and antigen presentation, distinguishing it from confusables on IL-12-driven Th1 differentiation and dendritic cell cytokine production.

qualifier: female mating, aggression and parenting
name: Female mating, aggressive and parental social behavior
rationale: All three members are social/reproductive behaviors, unlike confusables on stress and fear responses, exploration/locomotion or male reproductive physiology.

qualifier: inherited SLC35 and acetyl-CoA transporter disorders
name: Inherited defects of Golgi nucleotide-sugar and acetyl-CoA transporters
rationale: All members are diseases caused by defective SLC35 nucleotide-sugar or SLC33A1 acetyl-CoA transporters, distinct from confusables on normal nucleotide-sugar transport or ALG/glycosyltransferase CDGs.

qualifier: ER-centered, with Rab GTPase prenylation
name: ER-centered intermembrane lipid transfer and Rab GTPase prenylation
rationale: Members cover glycolipid, phospholipid, ceramide-1-phosphate and cholesterol transfer between ER and other membranes plus Rab geranylgeranylation/GEF activity, unlike confusables on phospholipid catabolism, flippases or mitochondria-ER contacts.

qualifier: mtDNA replication, transcription, mRNA stability and ribosome assembly
name: Mitochondrial DNA replication, transcription, mRNA stability and ribosome assembly
rationale: Members span mtDNA replication and repair, mitochondrial transcription, mRNA processing/turnover and mitoribosome assembly, whereas confusables cover mitochondrial translation steps or tRNA processing.

qualifier: FGFR3 activation and PI3K/phospholipase C branches
name: FGFR3 activation and FGFR PI3K/phospholipase C cascades
rationale: Members are FGFR PI3K and PLC-gamma cascades plus FGFR3 ligand binding and mutant signaling, distinguishing it from confusables on FRS/SHC-MAPK branches, FGFR1/2 isoforms or non-FGFR PI3K signaling.

qualifier: cholinergic transmission, synapse assembly and congenital myasthenia
name: Neuromuscular junction cholinergic transmission, assembly and congenital myasthenia
rationale: Members cover acetylcholine synthesis/secretion, NMJ transmission, AChR clustering, DGC/ECM synapse assembly and congenital myasthenic syndromes, unlike confusables on choline transport, nicotinic receptor subtypes or myogenesis.

qualifier: insulin and growth hormone
name: GPCR control of insulin and growth hormone secretion
rationale: Members share G protein-coupled receptor/adenylate cyclase regulation of insulin (GLP-1, GPR40, acetylcholine), glucagon-family and somatostatin receptors and GH secretion, unlike confusables on calcitonin/amylin, free fatty acid receptors or incretin synthesis.

qualifier: CXCR4-driven, of T cells, mast cells and astrocytes
name: CXCR4-driven chemotaxis of T cells, mast cells and astrocytes
rationale: Members concern positive chemotaxis/migration of T cells, mast cells and astrocytes with CXCL12-CXCR4 signaling, distinct from confusables on monocyte CCR2/CX3CR1, B cell/S1P or integrin-mediated homing.

qualifier: BMAL1/ROR/REV-ERB and PGC-1alpha/PPARA coupling
name: Circadian clock and PGC-1alpha control of energy metabolism
rationale: Members couple circadian transcription (BMAL1/CLOCK, ROR/REV-ERB, heme) with PGC-1alpha/PPARA-driven gluconeogenesis, beta-cell, thermogenic and mitochondrial biogenesis programs, unlike confusables on the core clock mechanism, adipogenesis or lipid homeostasis.

qualifier: neuron migration and axon guidance
name: Peripheral and cranial nerve neuron development and migration
rationale: Members cover DRG, cranial ganglion, trigeminal/facial/olfactory nerve and sympathetic neuron development with GnRH and branchiomotor migration/guidance, unlike confusables on hindbrain/spinal patterning, CNS axon guidance or glandular development.

qualifier: CENP-A centromeric chromatin assembly and histone acetylation
name: Chromosome condensation, CENP-A deposition and histone acetylation
rationale: Members cover mitotic/meiotic chromosome condensation, centromeric CENP-A nucleosome deposition, nucleosome assembly and protein acetylation, distinguishing it from confusables on cohesion, nuclear envelope dynamics or chromatin remodelers.

qualifier: fork reversal and DNA topological maintenance
name: Replication fork stress response and DNA topological maintenance
rationale: Members concern replication fork reversal, R-loops, topological change, topoisomerase cross-link repair and hydroxyurea/camptothecin responses, unlike confusables on telomere maintenance, ADP-ribosylation or chromatin assembly.

qualifier: receptor proteolytic activation and intracellular-domain transcription
name: Notch receptor proteolytic activation and NICD-driven transcription
rationale: Members share Notch receptor processing, regulated intramembrane proteolysis and NOTCH1-4 intracellular-domain transcription including oncogenic NOTCH1 mutants, distinguishing it from Wnt, Hedgehog and ERBB4 confusables.

qualifier: endothelin signaling in neural crest
name: Endothelin signaling in enteric neural crest and midgut development
rationale: Members link endothelin receptor signaling with neural crest migration, enteric nervous system and midgut development, unlike confusables on gut mesoderm, GI motility, hindbrain or sympathoadrenal development.

qualifier: SUMO conjugation cascade on nuclear protein substrates
name: SUMO conjugation cascade and SUMOylation of nuclear proteins
rationale: Members cover SUMO processing, E1/E2 transfer, desumoylation and SUMOylation of transcription, chromatin, repair and nuclear envelope proteins, distinct from confusables on nuclear pore and nucleocytoplasmic transport.

qualifier: APOBEC3 cytidine deamination
name: HIV entry, reverse transcription and APOBEC3 cytidine-deaminase restriction
rationale: Members cover HIV entry, uncoating and reverse transcription with APOBEC3G C-to-U deamination restriction and its Vif antagonism, unlike confusables on coronavirus replication, ADAR A-to-I editing or HIV integration.

qualifier: lipophagy and fatty acid import regulation
name: Triglyceride lipolysis, lipophagy and fatty acid import regulation
rationale: Members concern triglyceride catabolism, lipid droplet disassembly, lipophagy and regulation of fatty acid uptake and oxidation, distinguishing it from confusables on triglyceride synthesis and lipid droplet formation.
